code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Furnish/form/{ComposeList,ReplyComposeForm}.tsx, pages/Notice/hook/ActionNotice.tsx (modal konfirmasi), components/modal/ModalConfirm.tsx. ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi/ocmseserviceapi/ocmseserviceui/thirdpartyapi: tidak ada code terkait
note: Status: Demo paid (50% of 75%). The story asks the screen to show a summary of the email that will be sent at a scheduled time together with the reject decision, so the OIC can confirm or cancel. What exists: a send list (mode, recipient, To, CC, subject) with Preview and Remove buttons on the Reply tab, and a one-line confirmation modal 'Do you wish to proceed with the rejection?' on Submit. The email summary and the reject decision are not combined on one screen, the confirmation modal does not carry the email content, and there is no scheduled date/time to show because scheduling does not exist (see OCMS41.26). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Claim partially: send list, email preview and reject confirmation modal exist. A combined summary and the scheduled date/time are not built

steps.step: The screen shows the list of emails to be sent (recipient, CC, subject)
steps.detail: Every added entry goes into compose_list and is shown in a Datagrid with Message Mode, Recipient, Email To, Email CC, Subject columns (ComposeList.tsx:47-56). The grid is hidden when the list is empty (ComposeList.tsx:42).

steps.step: OIC can preview the email content before confirming
steps.detail: The Preview button opens a ModalBase 'Email Preview' showing the email content (ComposeList.tsx:61-62, 73-100); the Remove button deletes the entry from the list (ComposeList.tsx:66-67).

steps.step: The summary shows the scheduled send date and time
steps.detail: The summary grid has no date/time column (ComposeList.tsx:49-55) because no schedule value exists in the form or payload (ReplyComposeForm.tsx:68-83 stores composeKeys without a schedule). There is no schedule field or parameter anywhere: EmailRequest only has from/to/subject/htmlContent/cc/attachments (EmailRequest.java:12-17), the OcmsEmailNotificationRecords table only stores date_sent (OcmsEmailNotificationRecords.java:50), and the email form UI has no date/time input (ReplyEmail.tsx:31-60). Grep for scheduled/schedule/sendAt/sendLater in ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi: 0 relevant hits for furnish email.

steps.step: The summary shows the decision to reject the particulars update
steps.detail: The reject decision shows as the confirmation modal sentence 'Do you wish to proceed with the rejection?' (ActionNotice.tsx:190-193, 205-209) and Decision Status is visible in the OIC Review form (DecisionForm.tsx:438-447). There is no summary that combines the reject decision with the email to be sent: the email is on the Reply tab, the decision on another tab, and the modal does not detail the email.

steps.step: From the summary, the OIC decides to confirm or cancel
steps.detail: The confirmation modal has OK and Cancel buttons (ModalConfirm.tsx:36-48; default labels Cancel/Ok) so a decision can be made. But the modal only holds one generic sentence without email/schedule details, so the OIC decides without seeing a summary in that modal; the summary only exists in the Reply tab grid. Same fit as OCMS41.28 step 4.
